summary: Frontend-only deep-interaction retest completed on public preview; active-chapter behavior now matches user requirement and targeted controls work when their section is active.
action_items: No blocking issues found in requested frontend scope.
Optional: keep future regression tests chapter-scoped (activate chapter first, then test its controls).
critical_code_review_comments: Pointer-events gating in UnifiedSpatial.css is intentionally chapter-scoped and now aligns with expected interaction model.
SpatialExperience/StorySections remain heavily compressed single-line JSX, which increases debugging cost for future interaction regressions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated with route-first approach: __spatialGo('gallery'|'quotes'|'victories', {immediate:true}) then interact. Gallery next/previous changed scrollLeft, quote next/previous changed quote text, victories year filter updated active/count/list. Confirmed gallery controls are offscreen/non-interactive while victories is active (expected). Menu/hash smoke, timeline arrows smoke, no horizontal overflow, and no console errors in this run.
rca of the issue: Prior failure was a test-sequencing mismatch: attempting distant section controls while camera remained on a different active node. With explicit chapter activation before control interaction, behavior is correct and consistent with the user’s active-chapter requirement.
